reauth_confirm.title: Nexecur Hikvision - Authorise this terminal
reauth_confirm.description:
The Nexecur cloud does not recognise Home Assistant as an authorised device yet and has sent a verification code (by SMS or email, depending on your login method).

Enter that code to enrol Home Assistant once and for all. Your entities, history and automations are preserved.

error.code_request_failed: Could not request a verification code from the cloud. Try again in a few minutes.

abort.reauth_successful: Home Assistant is now authorised on your Nexecur account.
